# ISuperstateStandardArkEvents
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/events/arks/ISuperstateStandardArkEvents.sol)

**Title:**
ISuperstateStandardArkEvents

Events emitted by the Superstate standard Ark contract


## Events
### PendingDepositCleared
Emitted when a pending deposit is cleared


```solidity
event PendingDepositCleared(uint256 amountCleared);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amountCleared`|`uint256`|The amount of the pending deposit that was cleared|

### ArkIsFrozenUpdated
Emitted when the Ark frozen state is updated


```solidity
event ArkIsFrozenUpdated(bool isFrozen, uint256 frozenTotalAssets);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`isFrozen`|`bool`|Whether the Ark is now frozen|
|`frozenTotalAssets`|`uint256`|The total assets recorded at the time of freezing|
